name: unidpp-edge-services
description: UniDPP edge services on Cloudflare Workers: identity (actor registry, scoped API credentials) and resolver (RFC 9264 linksets with per-context routing). Implements  (identity-server) and #22 (resolver-deploy) for the JTC 5 plenary readiness (operator-model §2.2 role model; the UniDPP design framework §6 deployment map).
